faqs: What exactly does €3,000 include?

20 zirconia crowns, consultation and X-rays, clinically needed extractions or root canal treatment, a return flight ticket up to €300, 7 hotel nights with one companion’s accommodation, and airport and clinic transfers. Your written plan confirms your individual treatment.
How many crowns will I need?
Your dentist decides how many crowns are appropriate after reviewing your teeth. If your plan is not for 20 crowns, your consultant confirms the price in writing before any deposit.
Are my natural teeth reshaped?

Usually yes. Crowns generally require tooth preparation, which permanently removes part of the natural tooth. Your dentist explains suitability, alternatives, individual risks and follow-up before you decide.
How long will I stay in Istanbul?
Plan 7 nights for zirconia crowns. Your dentist confirms the dates in your plan.
Is my flight really included?

Yes. The return flight ticket is covered up to €300 per patient, and you pay any amount above that. Route, dates and booking arrangements are confirmed with your consultant before the ticket is bought.
Can someone come with me?
Yes. Accommodation for one companion is included for the 7-night stay. The flight allowance is for the patient, so the companion’s flight is paid separately.
When does this offer end?
The offer is valid until 31 December 2026. A deposit of at least €300 by that date secures the price once your treatment plan is confirmed. Treatment dates are agreed separately.
Where does treatment take place?
At a hospital dental centre in Istanbul. The hospital and treating dentist details are provided as part of your care plan.
What if I need implants?
Implants are outside this 20-crown package and are quoted separately before you confirm your plan.
What about material and warranty?
Ivoclar material and a 15-year crown warranty apply only where your written documents confirm them. Ask for the exact material, coverage, exclusions and aftercare conditions in writing.
What happens after I go home?

Before your return transfer you receive your care instructions and follow-up contact details. Crowns need ongoing care and regular reviews; longevity varies, and maintenance or replacement may be needed.
Is this treatment suitable for everyone?
No. Your dentist must assess your teeth, gums, existing restorations and clinical needs. Photos help preliminary planning; they do not replace an examination.
